name: Custom Shape Wooden Sewing Magnet Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - The box is crafted from premium 3mm wood, assembled into 4 sturdy layers:
                →  Lid: 2 wooden layers
                →  Box bottom: 2 wooden layers, including one flexible magnet layer to securely hold sewing needles in place.
    - The natural wood grain provides a warm, timeless look while ensuring durability and long-lasting use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Outer size (lid and box): Approximately 3 × 3 inches ~ 7.62 × 7.62 cm
    - Wood thickness: 3mm per layer (total thickness: 4 layers)
    - Magnet size (inside box bottom): Flexible magnet up to 3 × 1.5 inches ~ 7.6 × 3.8 cm
    - Round magnets: Ø5 mm (~0.2 in) used to help the lid stay aligned and close firmly.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology, ensuring vibrant, crisp, and long-lasting colors.
    - High-resolution details for personalized names, artwork, or icons
    - Double-sided printing, allowing both the inside and outside of the lid to feature clean, vivid graphics

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for holding small sewing essentials such as needles, pins, mini clips, or other craft accessories.
    - Smooth opening and closing thanks to the built-in magnets. 
    - Strong magnetic closure keeps all items safe and prevents accidental spills.
    - Compact, portable, and easy to carry in sewing kits, handbags, or travel cases.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion: 
    - This personalized wooden sewing magnet box makes a thoughtful and functional gift for:
                →  Sewers, quilters, tailors, crafters
                →  Moms, grandmothers, teachers, friends
                →  Birthdays, Mother’s Day, Christmas, anniversaries, or any meaningful celebration
    - Its custom design and practical magnetic function make it a charming keepsake suitable for everyone and any holiday or special moment.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Sewing Magnet Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
